shape.means: soft, generous corners; friendly and calm
chamfered corners and straight cuts; technical, urgent
edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth

label.means: a folded banner with forked tails
a saturated pill with a pointer line and a dot on the part (the classic)
a swallowtail flag on a pole planted at the part

bubble.means: an inked, cut-cornered bubble with a sharp wedge tail

a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs

panel.means: no fill: a double hairline with corner brackets, the title set into the rule
a solid colour block with a hard offset shadow
a filled card in the lesson's shape language (the classic)

icon.means: an open ring with a gap and a bead, icon inside
the icon alone, heavier, standing on a soft ground shadow
a soft colour blob behind, offset, icon in ink

mark.means: a ruled box ticked by hand, the mark overflowing it
a thick tapered brush stroke, no container
tick or cross knocked out of a disc (the classic)

texture.means: diagonal hatching in the shaded band

entrance.means: panels unroll top to bottom, labels wipe, bubbles open from the speaker
things slide in from the side they relate to
things pop in with a little overshoot (the classic)

camera.means: the camera pans along a process or a row (guidance for the storyboard)
